slots.name: Southeast Asians at risk
slots.sentence: The Iran war has imposed immediate costs on Southeast Asia by disrupting energy supplies, increasing fertilizer costs, raising risks for roughly 3 million Southeast Asians who live or work in the Middle East—including an estimated 2.4 million Filipinos—and disrupting remittance flows.
